definitions.explanation: A continuous stretch of land or space.
The entirety of a particular area.

examples.japanese: この{一帯|いったい}は{工業|こうぎょう}{地帯|ちたい}です。
examples.english: This area is an industrial zone.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}{周辺|しゅうへん}{一帯|いったい}が{開発|かいはつ}された。
examples.english: The entire area around the station was developed.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{一帯|いったい}に{雪|ゆき}が{積|つ}もった。
examples.english: Snow accumulated across the mountain region.

notes:
{一帯|いったい} refers to a continuous area or region.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- この{一帯|いったい} (this area)
- 〜{一帯|いったい} (the ~ area)
- {一帯|いったい}に (throughout the area)

NOTE:
- Different from {一体|いったい} (what on earth; body) - same reading, different kanji
- {一帯|いったい} specifically refers to geographical areas
